text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The last day of summer camp is here.<n>Everyone
has gathered around for a<n>nighttime barbecue,
myself and<n>Shinko Windy included.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on a fruitful summer camp!<n>♪ Let's raise
our glasses to all the<n>progress we've made...
Cheers! ☆

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: CHEEEEERS! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Meat! Meat! And more meat! Lackey,<n>fetch me that
rack of ribs, chop chop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, after feasting, the topic of<n>conversation
naturally turns to racing<n>and the future.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh? So you're set on running in the<n>Champions
Cup next.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yup! It's a super popular race, so I'm<n>gonna go
and surprise everyone!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Do so, and then perhaps<n>that bad
reputation of yours will finally<n>be shown out the
door. You sure have<n>been working hard, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! That's right! I'm the<n>baddest of the bad,
here to spark fear<n>in the hearts of racing fans
everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But I won't stop there! My<n>ambition's much, much
bigger than<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever forget that<n>all-important goal of
hers...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll become an Umamusume strong<n>enough to top
the rankings even a<n>hundred years from now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's gonna be me! The world will<n>remember me
as the big bad<n>Umamusume who struck fear into
everyone's hearts for a century and<n>beyond!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: O-oooh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Awesome, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's quite the dream... Do you have<n>any specific
goals in place to help<n>make it happen?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mrgh? Specific... like what?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well, um, like benchmarks to help you<n>stay on
track?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh! You're pretty sharp, Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lemme think... Ehhh... Win like mad,<n>make
headlines... then... I dunno—what<n>else do you think I
should do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ranking we saw last year was<n>just one of
many published by<n>numerous media outlets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To stay on the public's radar for a<n>whole century,
she might need to<n>achieve something of a more
official<n>character.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What if you won a URA award?<n>You could
become the Best Dirt<n>Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Best Dirt Umamusume, you say? The<n>URA decides
one of those every year,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that be wonderful? Getting<n>praised by the
URA directly would be<n>such an honor.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! Win that award, and your<n>name will get
put in the record books!<n>You know what? I think I'll
go for it<n>myself!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I saw a post online saying<n>you're already
doing well enough to<n>win that award this year,
Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... The URA's Best Dirt<n>Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right as we're about to finish<n>cleaning up after the
barbecue, I catch<n>Shinko Windy running off
somewhere<n>on her own.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hngh... The Best Dirt Umamusume...<n>the Best Dirt
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Lackey... Gimme some space. I need<n>to think.
choice_data_list: Is this about the Best Dirt Umamusume award?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah... you think I should go for it,<n>too?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmgh... It's just, ya know... are<n>awards really
all they're cracked up<n>to be?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've got no interest in getting buttered<n>up by some
bigwig sitting atop their<n>perch.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's not formal recognition I'm after. I<n>just want
people to ooh and aah and<n>talk about how
awesome I am.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to be like, "Wow,<n>she's so
amazing!" and then come<n>and fawn all over me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants pure recognition and<n>acclaim, not some
prestigious<n>decoration piece.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I mean, sure, I'd be happy to get the<n>award. It's a
big deal, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But, nrgh... Grrrr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not aiming to be number one,<n>but the one and
only.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what's the point of worrying<n>about it now
anyways? Doesn't<n>change what I gotta do.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I gotta work hard and win, win, WIN!Screw the award. I'mma makeeveryone look my way by winningmore than ever!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But if the Best Dirt Umamusume<n>award falls into my
lap along the way,<n>then sure—I'll take it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Win it, and she'll be officially<n>recognized as an
award winner,<n>which is sure to grab plenty of
attention from the public at large.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it won't leave the deep<n>impression on their
memories she's<n>trying to make.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right... If her goal is to really<n>make waves,
then...
choice_data_list: What if you declined the award?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You mean turn it down?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hold up... Has anyone ever done that<n>before?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is to stand out from the<n>rest. She'll need
to make headlines to<n>do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And what would make for a more<n>memorable
performance than<n>refusing the award on stage?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I get it, you want me to put on a<n>show!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Instead of just accepting the dumbaward, I can use it to my ownnefarious ends!
choice_data_list: Think of how stunned everyone will be!
Think of how stunned everyone will be!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oooh! "Stunned" is selling it short, if<n>you ask me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This'll be perfect for Wicked Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And I love that evil grin on your face,<n>Lackey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Turning down an award sounds<n>exactly like
something I'd do.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You've struck gold again, my<n>diabolical strategist!
I've gotta hand it<n>to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...As much as I know I shouldn't be,<n>I'm just as
excited as she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to get back at the people, at the<n>world, who
treated her like a passing<n>meme!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to hear them gasp with shock<n>at her true
strength!
choice_data_list: This will bring you one step closer to your ambition.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Tell me more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll need to hype her up as<n>much as
possible so the rejection<n>makes the biggest impact.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeeesss!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, we'll have her accomplish<n>something even
greater to cement her<n>legend!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that!
choice_data_list: Then finally, you'll pursue your true ambition!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now we're talking!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer... You're really something<n>else!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eheheheh... Heheheheheh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: BWAHAHAHA!<n>MWAAAHAHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We're takin' a bite outta this world...<n>and they
aren't ready!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I can't wait to see the look on<n>their faces!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our quest to pull off the<n>ultimate prank gets
underway. If we<n>can win first place at the
Champions<n>Cup, she'll have a very good chance<n>of
being selected as Best Dirt<n>Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Lackey. All of this stays<n>between us,
capisce?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First thing's first, I gotta get that<n>award! I've gotta
win, even if it kills<n>me! Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Champions Cup. For our<n>plan to work,
we absolutely have to<n>win this race!
